title: The Man Who Moved a Mountain
logline: In 1960, a poor labourer in Bihar named Dashrath Manjhi decided to move a mountain with just a hammer and chisel, working alone for 22 years.

scenes.narration: A man in India beat a mountain with a hammer.
In nineteen sixty, a poor labourer in Bihar named Dashrath Manjhi picked a fight.
Every single day, he climbed the hill and hit it.
The village laughed. They called him a madman.
One year became five. Five became twenty.
The mountain didn't fight back. It was too busy losing.
You see, it started when his wife fell on that hill.
The nearest doctor was fifty-five kilometres around it. She didn't make it.
After twenty-two years, he broke through. Fifty-five kilometres became fifteen. He couldn't get her past the mountain. So he moved the mountain.

title: The Unread Letter
logline: A 72-year-old illiterate widow wrote a letter to her late husband every day. On the last page, he wrote back.

title: The Road That Walked
logline: A doctor walked 18 kilometers through a monsoon to deliver a baby. Twice a day. For twenty-three years.

title: The Clockmaker Daughter
logline: Her blind father taught her to hear time. When the great blackout hit the city, she was the only one who knew when dawn would come.

title: The Last Tree Keeper
logline: A farmer planted one seed every year for seventy-four years. Nobody noticed. Until the sky turned green again.
